dial_resources.why: water stress is a level of freshwater; up means more shortage or contamination (bad)
land degradation is a level of land and soil; up means more land lost or degraded (bad)
biodiversity loss is a level of ecosystems and wildlife; up means more decline (bad)
climate stress is a level of air and climate; up means more hazard (bad)
air pollution is a level of air and climate; up means dirtier air (bad)
energy cost and supply is a level of energy sources (fuels, sun, wind, water); up means costlier or scarcer (bad)
mineral and material scarcity is a level of minerals and materials; up means scarcer or costlier (bad)
food insecurity is a level of food supply; up means more people short of food (bad)
housing cost is a level of housing stock; up means costlier (bad)
infrastructure condition is a level of built infrastructure; up means better repair (good)
disruption of services is a level of built infrastructure; up means more interruptions (bad)
industrial output is a level of productive capital; up means more output (good)
supply chain strain is a level of trade and supply links; up means more strain (bad)
technology adoption is a level of computing and networks; up means more adoption (neutral)
cyber insecurity is a level of computing and networks; up means more breaches (bad)
prices is a level of money and credit; up means higher prices (bad)
borrowing cost and credit access is a level of money and credit; up means costlier or tighter credit (bad)
asset values is a level of wealth and assets; up means higher values (good for holders)
market volatility is a level of wealth and assets; up means more volatility (bad)
private debt is a level of wealth and assets; up means heavier burden (bad)
economic inequality is a level of wealth and assets; up means wider gap (bad)
fiscal strain is a level of public finances; up means more strain (bad)
health risk is a level of population health; up means more risk (bad)
mental distress is a level of population health; up means more distress (bad)
care strain is a level of care capacity; up means more strain (bad)
job security is a level of labour; up means more secure (good)
pay growth is a level of labour; up means faster pay growth (good)
social division is a level of social trust and cohesion; up means more division (bad)
community strength is a level of community ties; up means stronger (good)
trust in institutions is a level of legitimacy; up means more trust (good)
public service quality is a level of state capacity and public safety; up means better (good)
civil liberties is a level of legitimacy; up means more freedom (good)
crime is a level of state capacity and public safety; up means more crime (bad)
war and terror is a level of state capacity and public safety; up means more conflict (bad)
civil unrest is a level of state capacity and public safety; up means more unrest (bad)
information reliability is a level of knowledge and information; up means more reliable (good)
news overload is a level of time and attention; up means more news competing (bad)
migration flow is a level of population; up means more net arrivals (neutral)
skills level is a level of learned ability; up means more people with needed skills (good)

shortages and delays raise shelf prices

dials.name: Water stress
dials.definition: How short or unsafe water supply is for a place.
dials.grounding_series: water stress / safe drinking water access

dials.name: Land degradation
dials.definition: Loss of usable farmland, forest and soil through erosion, fire, flooding or sprawl.

dials.name: Biodiversity loss
dials.definition: Decline of species, habitats and fish stocks.

dials.name: Climate stress
dials.definition: How severe heat, drought, flood and storm hazard is compared with normal.

dials.name: Air pollution
dials.definition: Concentration of harmful particles and gases in the air.

dials.name: Energy cost and supply
dials.definition: How expensive and how available fuel, electricity and heating are.
dials.grounding_series: energy price index, fuel price, supply margins

dials.name: Mineral and material scarcity
dials.definition: How hard it is to obtain metals and raw materials.

dials.name: Food insecurity
dials.definition: Share of people who cannot reliably get enough affordable food.
dials.grounding_series: food price index, prevalence of undernourishment

dials.name: Housing cost
dials.definition: Rent, house prices and mortgage cost relative to income.

dials.name: Infrastructure condition
dials.definition: How well roads, grids, pipes and public buildings are maintained.

dials.name: Disruption of services
dials.definition: Interruptions to travel, power, water and public services.
dials.grounding_series: outage minutes, delay and cancellation rates

dials.name: Industrial output
dials.definition: How much goods production is running relative to capacity.

dials.name: Supply chain strain
dials.definition: Delays, shortages and trade barriers in moving goods.
dials.grounding_series: supply delivery times, tariff and freight indices

dials.name: Technology adoption
dials.definition: Share of daily life and work done with newer digital tools.

dials.name: Cyber insecurity
dials.definition: How exposed digital systems are to breaches and outages.

dials.name: Prices
dials.definition: How expensive everyday goods and services are, i.e. how little a unit of money buys.

dials.name: Borrowing cost and credit access
dials.definition: How costly and available loans are.
dials.grounding_series: policy rate, lending rates, credit survey

dials.name: Asset values
dials.definition: Level of share, property and savings values.

dials.name: Market volatility
dials.definition: How violently asset prices are swinging.

dials.name: Private debt
dials.definition: Share of income that households and firms owe in repayments.

dials.name: Economic inequality
dials.definition: Gap between richest and poorest in income and wealth (the Gini coefficient is the usual single number for it).

dials.name: Fiscal strain
dials.definition: Pressure on government budgets from deficits, debt and spending needs.
dials.grounding_series: deficit and debt to output, bond yields

dials.name: Health risk
dials.definition: Exposure to illness, injury and disease outbreak.

dials.name: Mental distress
dials.definition: Share of people with anxiety, depression or stress.

dials.name: Care strain
dials.definition: Pressure on hospitals, clinics, staff and medicine supply.

dials.name: Job security
dials.definition: How secure people's jobs and work availability are.

dials.name: Pay growth
dials.definition: How fast pay is rising, before any price rises are taken off.

dials.name: Social division
dials.definition: Polarisation and unfairness between groups.

dials.name: Community strength
dials.definition: How connected and supportive local communities are.

dials.name: Trust in institutions
dials.definition: How credibly government, business and media are seen to act.

dials.name: Public service quality
dials.definition: How well government delivers schools, courts, permits and benefits.

dials.name: Civil liberties
dials.definition: How freely people can speak, vote, assemble and get fair legal treatment.
dials.grounding_series: freedom and rule of law indices

dials.name: Crime
dials.definition: Crime and violence around people's daily life.

dials.name: War and terror
dials.definition: Armed conflict and terrorism affecting the audience's country or region.

dials.name: Civil unrest
dials.definition: Level of riots, mass protest and disorder.

dials.name: Information reliability
dials.definition: How accurate and trustworthy public information is.

dials.name: News overload
dials.definition: Share of audience attention taken up by news volume.

dials.name: Migration flow
dials.definition: How many people are arriving in or leaving a place, relative to its population.

dials.name: Skills and education level
dials.definition: How far the people of a place have the education and skills they need for work and life.
dials.grounding_series: educational attainment and adult skills survey results
dials.status: draft v2 (half-life is a guess: median of the human-resource conditions, 225)

loop.name: ingest
loop.what_happens: read new report lines from the ledger; dial changes from classifier readings; news_overload from report count

loop.name: dial_update
loop.what_happens: each dial: multiply by event factors, then drift back toward 1 at its own half-life; optimism computed from the others

loop.name: perceive
loop.what_happens: each persona perceives each dial through its own salience (and region, once regional dials exist)

loop.name: modify_elements
loop.what_happens: effective element = base element x product over dials of perceived dial ^ strength (grid)

loop.name: persist
loop.what_happens: blend with the previous state (inertia), as in ConsumerSim; strength fitted on a calibration period

loop.name: gates
loop.what_happens: for each decision met this tick, act with probability sigmoid(bias + sum of weights x standardised elements)

loop.name: log
loop.what_happens: write dial values, events, per-cohort rates and the cause of each change to the ledger

sowhat_frames.probe_statement: This story is about a sudden hit to one place, company or industry that falls hardest on the people there.
sowhat_frames.status: draft (guess; probe tested once on 22 design fixtures)

sowhat_frames.name: Shake-up
sowhat_frames.definition: A change in how things work (a new tool, a new rule, a broken service) that pushes people to switch or adapt.
sowhat_frames.probe_statement: This story is about a change in how things work, such as a new technology, a new rule or a broken service, that makes people switch or adapt.
sowhat_frames.status: draft (guess; probe tested once on 22 design fixtures)

sowhat_frames.name: Surge
sowhat_frames.definition: Something climbs fast (home or share prices, demand, arrivals) and people pile in or scramble to keep up.
sowhat_frames.probe_statement: This story is about something climbing fast, such as home or share prices, demand, or the number of people arriving.
sowhat_frames.status: draft (guess; probe tested once on 22 design fixtures)

sowhat_frames.name: Freeze
sowhat_frames.definition: Uncertainty, more than cost, makes people wait: big decisions get put off.
sowhat_frames.probe_statement: This story is about uncertainty that makes people wait and put off big decisions.
sowhat_frames.status: draft (guess; probe tested once on 22 design fixtures)

sowhat_frames.name: Rift
sowhat_frames.definition: Politics, unfairness or conflict between groups, so people take sides and speak up.
sowhat_frames.probe_statement: This story is about a political fight, unfairness or conflict between groups that makes people take sides.
sowhat_frames.status: draft (guess; probe tested once on 22 design fixtures)

sowhat_frames.name: Boost
sowhat_frames.definition: A gain (a cure, an investment, better services) that makes life easier or safer.
sowhat_frames.probe_statement: This story is about a gain, such as a new cure, new investment or better services, that makes life easier or safer.
sowhat_frames.status: draft (guess; probe tested once on 22 design fixtures)

sowhat_frames.name: Ripple
sowhat_frames.definition: A story people hear about that changes little in daily life.
sowhat_frames.probe_statement: This story changes little in most people's daily lives.
sowhat_frames.status: draft (guess; probe tested once on 22 design fixtures)

reading.rule: a condition moves when, for one direction only, an attribute's two wordings average >= attribute_min; both directions = conflict (no move)

places.chain: world -> each country -> its metro, town and rural parts
places.country_to_settlement_gain: 1 + 0.1 x noise per condition, clipped to 0.7..1.3 (fixed seed 1234)
places.anchor: each country starts at its d_<condition> columns; the world is the population-weighted mean

time.condition_ties: a tie adds strength x amount to the target condition at the same place one tick later; at most 3 tie hops in a row
